summary: Frontend UI verification of Operator → Check Sheets → Scheduled Maintenance Tasks (MaintenanceTab.js). All acceptance criteria met: Yearly filter pill works; Add Task inline form (title/equipment/frequency select incl. Yearly) creates a custom task with 'Maintenance task added' toast and yearly badge; per-task <select task-frequency-select-{id}> toggles a built-in task (id=1) from Daily → Quarterly and persists across refresh; the Quarterly filter now includes the toggled task; custom tasks show a delete button (task-delete-*) while built-in tasks do NOT; deleting shows 'Task removed' toast and removes the row. Cleanup performed (custom QA task deleted, built-in task 1 reverted to Daily).
critical_code_review_comments: MaintenanceTab.js uses window.confirm for delete — works but native dialog is inconsistent with the app's shadcn styling; consider AlertDialog for parity with other destructive actions.
changeFrequency shows no success toast — silent write. Considering adding a subtle confirmation toast (or optimistic UI) so operators know the change persisted.
Frequency <select> uses native HTML select — mixes with theme but styling is minimal; acceptable for now.
seed_data_creation: Created + deleted 'QA Lubricate Belt' (Yearly) custom task on iso-demo-org. Toggled built-in task id=1 Daily→Quarterly then reverted to Daily.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 acceptance points confirmed. Baseline shows 34 tasks. Yearly filter starts empty, +1 after add, -1 after delete. task-frequency-select-1 change persists after list refresh. Note: /api/auth/login is aggressively rate-limited — space browser sessions ~40s apart.
